description: Bind an external ID to a xuanchu user. Use provider + user_type to describe the ID (e.g. provider=feishu, user_type=user_id). Admin/owner can bind for others; regular users can only bind to themselves.

provider.description: external ID provider, e.g. feishu, wecom, dingtalk

user_type.description: ID type within the provider, e.g. user_id, open_id, union_id. Defaults to user_id

name: user_bind
